structure Input where
  runtime : StudyAdmission.Artifact
  handoffChars : Nat
  pluginRoot : String
  pluginFiles : Array StudyAdmission.Artifact
  environment : Array (String × Option String)
  deriving FromJson, ToJson

private def check (condition : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit :=
  unless condition do throw (IO.userError message)

/-- Reject an incomplete experimental installation before creating a DB or
calling hooks. The native fixture requires the existing numerical support;
it neither installs a runtime nor substitutes a model. -/
def requireNumericalSupport (plan : Input) : IO Unit := do
  let executable := System.FilePath.mk plan.runtime.path
  let installation := executable.parent.get!.parent.get!
  check ((plan.environment.find? (·.1 == "EGGSHELL_PREFIX")).bind Prod.snd == some installation.toString)
    "native fixture must use its sealed runtime's installed prefix"
  let paths := MiniLM.layout installation
  check ((← MiniLM.runtimePython? paths).isSome && (← paths.models.isDir))
    "native fixture lacks installed MiniLM support; no hooks or DB were started"

private def replaceEnv (original updates : Array (String × Option String)) :=
  original.filter (fun row => !updates.any (·.1 == row.1)) ++ updates

private def save (path : System.FilePath) (value : Json) : IO Unit :=
  IO.FS.writeFile path (value.compress ++ "\n")

private def checkedWarm (output : StudyCommand.Result) (database : System.FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  discard <| StudyReadiness.warm output database

private def config (binary database : String) (chars : Nat) : IO String := do
  return StudyProfile.render binary database (← IO.ofExcept (StudyProfile.checked chars))

private def origins (database : System.FilePath) (count : Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let deadline := (← IO.monoMsNow)+20000
  repeat
    let snapshot ← DB.PageMap.pin database
    if (← Provenance.records snapshot).size == count then return
    check ((← IO.monoMsNow) < deadline) "actual save worker did not publish every tool origin"
    IO.sleep 25

private def facts (database : System.FilePath) (ready : Array Fact → Bool) : IO (Array Fact) := do
  let deadline := (← IO.monoMsNow)+20000
  repeat
    let snapshot ← DB.PageMap.pin database
    if let some reader ← Index.open? snapshot .database .shared then
      let all ← Index.allFacts reader.index
      if ready all then return all
    check ((← IO.monoMsNow) < deadline) "actual index worker did not publish the expected synaptic facts"
    IO.sleep 25

private def isConsumption : Fact → Bool
  | .consumed edge => edge.consumer.useId == "consume" && edge.producer.useId == "read" &&
      edge.rows.any (·.first == 11)
  | _ => false

private def supported : Fact → Bool
  | .supports _ => true
  | _ => false

private def coquoted : Fact → Bool
  | .coquoted _ _ => true
  | _ => false

private def genericAliases (source : DB.PageMap.Snapshot) : IO Nat := do
  let reader ← Persistence.Store.NodeReader.new source
  let origins ← Provenance.records source
  let some origin := origins.find? (fun row => row.origin.occurrence.useId == "generic") |
    throw (IO.userError "generic native output was not published")
  let document ← Provenance.checkedDocument reader origin.origin
  let some capture ← ContentMetadata.load? source origin.origin.owner document |
    throw (IO.userError "generic output lost its atomic correspondence status")
  check (capture.complete && capture.aliases.size == 15)
    "actual arbitrary provider did not preserve all unique literal file lines"
  let catalog ← IO.ofExcept (ContentMetadata.catalog source.head.identity document capture)
  check (catalog.located.size == 15) "native aliases did not reach the original coordinate catalog"
  return capture.aliases.size

/-- The wanted quote is strictly inside an original spelling, not equal to a
whole saved record or supported through a file-coordinate citation. -/
private def literalSupport (source : DB.PageMap.Snapshot) (facts : Array Fact)
    (wanted : String) : IO Bool := do
  let reader ← Persistence.Store.NodeReader.new source
  let index := LiteralSearch.prepare #[wanted]
  for fact in facts do
    let .supports support := fact | continue
    if support.source.file?.isSome || !support.read.quotations.contains (Quotes.digest wanted) then continue
    let some id ← Build.ownerId? source support.binding.owner | continue
    let doc ← Build.document reader id
    let some raw := doc.source | continue
    let some catalog := ObservationContext.recorded source.head.identity doc | continue
    let text := String.ofList ((raw.toList.drop support.binding.first).take
      (support.binding.limit-support.binding.first))
    if (text.splitOn wanted).length ≤ 1 then continue
    -- Partial quotation deliberately replaces the parent's whole-spelling
    -- digests with the matched quote. Verify strictness against the immutable
    -- parent and require its checked projection to equal the persisted Read.
    for parent in catalog.quotations do
      if parent.text.length ≤ wanted.length then continue
      for hit in LiteralSearch.first index parent.text do
        let some witness := parent.locate? hit.first hit.limit | continue
        if witness.read == support.read then return true
  return false

/-- Freeze required DB-present source rows before a new chat's real hook runs.
This is a small model-free check of the audit wiring, not the recall study. -/
def recall (plan : Input) (root source : System.FilePath)
    (environment : Array (String × Option String))
    (reportRoot : Option System.FilePath := none) : IO Unit := do
  let workspace := root
  let root := reportRoot.getD root
  let snapshot := root / "recall-source.egg"
  let files ← StudyRuntime.checkpoint source snapshot
  let question := "Show the saved source evidence for NEEDED_SYMBOL and OTHER_SYMBOL."
  let frozen := Json.mkObj [
    ("source",toJson snapshot.toString),("workspace",toJson workspace.toString),("prompt",toJson question),
    ("files",toJson files),("required",toJson #[
      Json.mkObj [("name",toJson "needed-symbol"),("path",toJson "src/source.cpp"),
        ("first",toJson (11 : Nat)),("last",toJson (11 : Nat))],
      Json.mkObj [("name",toJson "other-symbol"),("path",toJson "src/source.cpp"),
        ("first",toJson (14 : Nat)),("last",toJson (14 : Nat))]])]
  save (root / "recall-required-before-delivery.json") frozen
  let configuration := root / "recall-config.toml"
  IO.FS.writeFile configuration (StudyProfile.render plan.runtime.path source.toString
    (← IO.ofExcept (StudyProfile.checked plan.handoffChars)) false)
  let data := root / "recall-data"
  IO.FS.createDir data
  let session := "native-recall-preflight"
  let environment := replaceEnv environment #[
    ("EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT",some data.toString),("EGGSHELL_CONFIG",some configuration.toString),
    ("CODEX_THREAD_ID",none),("CODEX_TURN_ID",none)]
  let publisher ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) data environment
  let managed ← try
    discard <| StudyReadiness.finishJournal plan.runtime.path source environment workspace.toString (root/"recall-replay") .user
    let warm ← StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["egg","warm","work"] environment workspace.toString ""
      (root / "recall-warm") 60000
    check (warm.exitCode == 0) "readonly recall source was not warmed"
    checkedWarm warm source
    StudyRuntime.startManaged (.mk plan.runtime.path) (.mk plan.pluginRoot) session
      (data / "daemon.json") environment
    catch error =>
      StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (root / "recall-publisher-shutdown.json")
      throw error
  let command := root / "recall-hook"
  try
    let input := Json.mkObj [("hook_event_name",toJson "UserPromptSubmit"),
      ("session_id",toJson session),("turn_id",toJson "recall-turn"),("cwd",toJson workspace.toString),
      ("prompt",toJson question),("_eggshell_config",toJson configuration.toString)]
    let output ← StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["codex-hook"] environment workspace.toString
      (input.compress ++ "\n") command 35000
    check (output.exitCode == 0) "readonly recall hook failed"
    let reply ← IO.ofExcept (Json.parse output.stdout)
    let body := (reply.getObjVal? "hookSpecificOutput" >>= (·.getObjValAs? String "additionalContext")).toOption.getD ""
    IO.FS.writeFile (root / "recall-body.txt") body
  finally
    try StudyRuntime.stopManaged managed (root / "recall-shutdown.json")
    finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (root / "recall-publisher-shutdown.json")
  let audit := Json.mkObj [("source",frozen),("database",toJson source.toString),
    ("request",toJson (command / "stdin").toString),("stdout",toJson (command / "stdout").toString),
    ("timing",toJson (command / "record.json").toString),("body",toJson (root / "recall-body.txt").toString)]
  save (root / "recall-audit-input.json") audit
  let report ← NativeTrialAudit.inspect (root / "recall-audit-input.json").toString
  save (root / "recall-audit.json") report
  let result ← IO.ofExcept (report.getObjVal? "requiredDelivery")
  check ((result.getObjValAs? Nat "eligible").toOption == some 2) "recall denominator lacks frozen DB-present originals"
  check ((result.getObjValAs? Bool "targetMet").toOption == some true) "actual readonly hook omitted required fixture evidence"
  check (((report.getObjValD "availableDelivery").getObjValAs? Bool "targetMet").toOption == some true)
    "actual readonly hook omitted fully or partially stored fixture evidence"

/-- The fixture writes no relations. Only real hooks, a real shell, the save
worker and the index worker may create its observations and consumption. -/
def run (templatePath directory : String) (remote : Bool := false)
    (literal : Bool := false) (generic : Bool := false) (additionalCalls : Nat := 0) : IO Unit := do
  let plan ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := Input) (← StudyAdmission.readJson templatePath))
  StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact plan.runtime
  for artifact in plan.pluginFiles do StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact artifact
  requireNumericalSupport plan
  let root := System.FilePath.mk directory
  check (root.isAbsolute && !(← root.pathExists)) "a new absolute fixture directory is required"
  check ((← IO.getEnv "EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT") == some (root / "data").toString)
    "fixture observer and native hooks need the same isolated private data root"
  Persistence.rejectSymlinkAncestors root
  IO.FS.createDir root
  IO.FS.createDir (root / "data")
  IO.FS.createDir (root / "src")
  let lines := (List.range 10).map (fun i => s!"prefix_{i+1}") ++
    ["NEEDED_SYMBOL", "alpha", "beta", "OTHER_SYMBOL", "omega"]
  IO.FS.writeFile (root / "src/source.cpp") ("\n".intercalate lines ++ "\n")
  let database := root / "work.egg"
  let initial ← DB.PageMap.create database (Persistence.valueToJson (.text "native-seed-fixture")).compress
  check ((← Build.entries initial).isEmpty) "synthetic seed did not start with an empty database"
  let configuration := root / "config.toml"
  IO.FS.writeFile configuration (← config plan.runtime.path database.toString plan.handoffChars)
  let session := "native-empty-seed"
  let turn := "seed-turn"
  let environment := replaceEnv plan.environment #[
    ("EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT",some (root / "data").toString),
    ("EGGSHELL_CONFIG",some configuration.toString),("EGGSHELL_PROFILE",some "work"),
    ("CODEX_THREAD_ID",some session),("CODEX_TURN_ID",some turn)]
  let call := fun label args input => do
    let result ← StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path args environment root.toString input (root / label) 35000
    check (result.exitCode == 0 && result.elapsedMs < 30000) s!"native {label} failed or expired: {result.stderr}"
    return result
  let hook := fun label fields => do
    let input := Json.mkObj ([("session_id",toJson session),("turn_id",toJson turn),
      ("cwd",toJson root.toString),("_eggshell_config",toJson configuration.toString)] ++ fields)
    let result ← call label #["codex-hook"] (input.compress ++ "\n")
    let _ ← IO.ofExcept (Json.parse result.stdout)
    pure ()
  let endpoint := root / "data/daemon.json"
  let publisher ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) (root / "data") environment
  let managed ← try
    StudyRuntime.startManaged (.mk plan.runtime.path) (.mk plan.pluginRoot) session endpoint environment
    catch error =>
      StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (root / "publisher-shutdown.json")
      throw error
  try
    hook "SessionStart" [("hook_event_name",toJson "SessionStart")]
    hook "UserPromptSubmit" [("hook_event_name",toJson "UserPromptSubmit"),
      ("prompt",toJson "inspect the source symbols and their recorded evidence")]
    let commands := #[
      ("read", "nl -ba src/source.cpp | sed -n '10p;11,12p' && nl -ba src/source.cpp | sed -n '14p'"),
      ("consume", "printf NEEDED_SYMBOL"),
      ("other", "nl -ba src/source.cpp | sed -n '13,15p'"),
      ("reread", "nl -ba src/source.cpp | sed -n '10,12p'")]
    let remoteCalls : Array Plugin.ToolEvent := (if !remote then #[] else #[
      {name := "mcp__catalog__lookup",useId := "remote-lookup",input := "{}"
       response := (toJson #[Json.mkObj [("id",toJson "RECORD_42"),
          ("uri",toJson "smb://customer/logs/boot.txt")]]).compress},
      {name := "mcp__catalog__inspect",useId := "remote-inspect"
       input := (Json.mkObj [("request",Json.mkObj [("record",toJson "RECORD_42")])]).compress
       response := (Json.mkObj [("status",toJson "available")]).compress}]) ++
      (if remote && literal then #[
        {name := "mcp__catalog__formula",useId := "remote-symbol",input := "{}"
         response := (Json.mkObj [("formula",toJson "lookup(NEEDED_SYMBOL)")]).compress}]
        else #[])
    let toolCount := commands.size+remoteCalls.size+(if generic then 1 else 0)+additionalCalls
    let remoteConsumption := fun all => !remote || all.any (fun fact => match fact with
      | .consumed edge => edge.producer.useId == "remote-lookup" && edge.consumer.useId == "remote-inspect" &&
          edge.kind == .value && edge.term == (toJson "RECORD_42").compress && !edge.rows.isEmpty
      | _ => false)
    for index in [:commands.size] do
      let (useId, command) := commands[index]!
      let input := Json.mkObj [("command",toJson command)]
      let fields := [("tool_name",toJson "shell"),("tool_use_id",toJson useId),("tool_input",input)]
      hook (useId ++ "-Pre") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PreToolUse")])
      let actual ← StudyCommand.run "/bin/sh" #["-c",command] environment root.toString ""
        (root / (useId ++ "-actual")) 5000
      check (actual.exitCode == 0) "fixture shell command failed"
      hook (useId ++ "-Post") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PostToolUse"),
        ("tool_response",Json.mkObj [("output",toJson actual.stdout),("exitCode",toJson actual.exitCode)])])
      origins database (index+1)
    for (tool,index) in remoteCalls.zipIdx do
      let fields := [("tool_name",toJson tool.name),("tool_use_id",toJson tool.useId),
        ("tool_input",← IO.ofExcept (Json.parse tool.input))]
      hook (tool.useId ++ "-Pre") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PreToolUse")])
      hook (tool.useId ++ "-Post") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PostToolUse"),
        ("tool_response",← IO.ofExcept (Json.parse tool.response))])
      origins database (commands.size+index+1)
    if generic then
      let command := "awk '{print FILENAME \":\" NR \":\" $0}' src/source.cpp"
      let input := Json.mkObj [("opaque_job",toJson command)]
      let fields := [("tool_name",toJson "arbitrary_provider"),("tool_use_id",toJson "generic"),
        ("tool_input",input)]
      hook "generic-Pre" (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PreToolUse")])
      let actual ← StudyCommand.run "/bin/sh" #["-c",command] environment root.toString ""
        (root / "generic-actual") 5000
      check (actual.exitCode == 0) "generic fixture command failed"
      hook "generic-Post" (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PostToolUse"),
        ("tool_response",Json.mkObj [("opaque_result",toJson actual.stdout)])])
      origins database (commands.size+remoteCalls.size+1)
    for index in [:additionalCalls] do
      let useId := s!"additional-{index}"
      let shell := index % 3 == 0
      let name := if shell then "shell" else if index % 3 == 1 then "mcp__cases__lookup" else "mcp__cases__inspect"
      let command := s!"printf 'CASE_{index}\\n'"
      let input := if shell then Json.mkObj [("command",toJson command)] else
        if index % 3 == 1 then Json.mkObj [("case",toJson index)] else
          Json.mkObj [("record",toJson s!"CASE_{index-1}")]
      let fields := [("tool_name",toJson name),("tool_use_id",toJson useId),("tool_input",input)]
      hook (useId ++ "-Pre") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PreToolUse")])
      let response ← if shell then do
        let actual ← StudyCommand.run "/bin/sh" #["-c",command] environment root.toString ""
          (root / (useId ++ "-actual")) 5000
        check (actual.exitCode == 0) "additional real shell command failed"
        pure (Json.mkObj [("output",toJson actual.stdout),("exitCode",toJson actual.exitCode)])
      else pure (if index % 3 == 1 then Json.mkObj [("id",toJson s!"CASE_{index}"),
        ("uri",toJson s!"smb://customer/case-{index}/log")] else Json.mkObj [("checked",toJson index)])
      hook (useId ++ "-Post") (fields ++ [("hook_event_name",toJson "PostToolUse"),("tool_response",response)])
      origins database (commands.size+remoteCalls.size+(if generic then 1 else 0)+index+1)
    let answer := if literal then
        "The symbol `NEEDED_SYMBOL` and remote location `customer/logs` are supported by [first](src/source.cpp:11) and [second](src/source.cpp:14)."
      else "The symbols are supported by [first](src/source.cpp:11) and [second](src/source.cpp:14)."
    hook "Stop" [("hook_event_name",toJson "Stop"),("last_assistant_message",toJson answer)]
    let _ ← call "keep" #["egg","keep"] ""
    let all ← facts database fun all => all.any isConsumption && all.any supported && all.any coquoted && remoteConsumption all
    let snapshot ← DB.PageMap.pin database
    if literal then
      for wanted in ["NEEDED_SYMBOL","customer/logs"] do
        check (← literalSupport snapshot all wanted) s!"original substring quote lost its support: {wanted}"
    let stored ← Provenance.records snapshot
    check (stored.size == toolCount && stored.all (fun row => row.origin.valid && row.origin.occurrence.session == session))
      "native origins lost their source or temporal binding"
    let sourceReader ← Persistence.Store.NodeReader.new snapshot
    let capturedAliases ← if generic then genericAliases snapshot else pure 0
    let mut checkedRows := 0
    for origin in stored do
      if origin.origin.occurrence.useId != "read" then continue
      let document ← Provenance.checkedDocument sourceReader origin.origin
      let rows ← IO.ofExcept (Extraction.recordedRows snapshot.head.identity document)
      check (rows.map (·.source.first) == #[10,11,12,14])
        "actual conditional read lost coordinates or filled a gap"
      checkedRows := checkedRows+rows.size
    check (checkedRows == 4) "conditional read was not checked in the saved source"
    let journal ← Journal.prepare snapshot
    let entries ← Journal.turnEntries journal ⟨session,turn⟩
    check (entries.size == toolCount*2+1) "native Pre/Post/Stop journal is incomplete"
    let mut usage : Array Fact := #[]
    if let some reader ← Index.open? snapshot .user .usage then usage ← Index.allFacts reader.index
    save (root / "facts.json") (toJson all)
    save (root / "origins.json") (toJson (stored.map (·.origin)))
    save (root / "usage.json") (toJson usage)
    save (root / "result.json") (Json.mkObj [
      ("runtime",toJson plan.runtime),("emptyInitialDatabase",toJson true),
      ("actualShellCalls",toJson (commands.size+(if generic then 1 else 0)+(additionalCalls+2)/3)),
      ("genericContentAliases",toJson capturedAliases),
      ("McpShapedHookPairs",toJson (remoteCalls.size+additionalCalls-(additionalCalls+2)/3)),
      ("realMcpServerUsed",toJson false),("nativeToolCalls",toJson toolCount),
      ("nativeJournalEvents",toJson entries.size),
      ("portableOrigins",toJson stored.size),("consumptionWitnesses",toJson (all.filter isConsumption).size),
      ("conditionalReadRows",toJson checkedRows),
      ("literalSubstringChecks",toJson (if literal then 2 else (0 : Nat))),
      ("supports",toJson (all.filter supported).size),("coquoted",toJson (all.filter coquoted).size),
      ("privateUsage",toJson usage.size),("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),
      ("directRelationInsertions",toJson (0 : Nat))])
  finally
    try StudyRuntime.stopManaged managed (root / "shutdown.json")
    finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (root / "publisher-shutdown.json")
  let preparation ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) (root/"data") environment
  let prepared ← try
    discard <| StudyReadiness.finishJournal plan.runtime.path database environment root.toString (root/"finish-replay")
    StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["egg","warm","work"] environment root.toString ""
      (root / "final-warm") 60000
    finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged preparation (root/"preparation-publisher-shutdown.json")
  checkedWarm prepared database
  let copied := root / "output.egg"
  let publication ← StudyRuntime.checkpoint database copied
  save (root / "publication-files.json") (toJson publication)
  let recoveryData := root / "recovery-data"
  IO.FS.createDir recoveryData
  let recoveryConfig := root / "recovery-config.toml"
  IO.FS.writeFile recoveryConfig (← config plan.runtime.path copied.toString plan.handoffChars)
  let recoveredEnvironment := replaceEnv environment #[
    ("EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT",some recoveryData.toString),("EGGSHELL_CONFIG",some recoveryConfig.toString),
    ("CODEX_THREAD_ID",none),("CODEX_TURN_ID",none)]
  let recovery ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) recoveryData recoveredEnvironment
  let warmed ← try
    discard <| StudyReadiness.finishJournal plan.runtime.path copied recoveredEnvironment root.toString (root/"recover-replay")
    StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["egg","warm","work"] recoveredEnvironment root.toString ""
      (root / "recover-warm") 60000
    finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged recovery (root/"recovery-publisher-shutdown.json")
  check (warmed.exitCode == 0) "source-only seed could not be warmed without its old private state"
  checkedWarm warmed copied
  let recovered ← facts copied fun all => all.any isConsumption && all.any supported && all.any coquoted
  if generic then
    check ((← genericAliases (← DB.PageMap.pin copied)) == 15)
      "source-only recovery lost command-independent coordinates"
  if literal then
    for wanted in ["NEEDED_SYMBOL","customer/logs"] do
      check (← literalSupport (← DB.PageMap.pin copied) recovered wanted)
        s!"source-only reconstruction lost substring support: {wanted}"
  check ((← StudyRuntime.files copied) == publication) "recovering derived synapses changed the source publication"
  save (root / "recovery.json") (Json.mkObj [
    ("runtime",toJson plan.runtime),("sourceOnlyCheckpoint",toJson true),
    ("newPrivateRoot",toJson true),("publicationUnchanged",toJson true),
    ("consumptionWitnesses",toJson (recovered.filter isConsumption).size),
    ("supports",toJson (recovered.filter supported).size),
    ("coquoted",toJson (recovered.filter coquoted).size)])
  if remote then recall plan root copied environment

def cliMain (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  try
    let [template,directory] := args | throw (IO.userError "StudySeedChecks TEMPLATE NEW-DIRECTORY")
    Eggshell.Research.StudySeedChecks.run template directory
    return 0
  catch error =>
    IO.eprintln error.toString
    return 1

end Eggshell.Research.StudySeedChecks

open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Research

namespace Eggshell.Research.NativeSeedFinalize

private def check (condition : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit :=
  unless condition do throw (IO.userError message)

private def replaceEnv (original updates : Array (String × Option String)) :=
  original.filter (fun row => !updates.any (·.1 == row.1)) ++ updates

private def queued (directory : System.FilePath) : IO (Array String) := do
  let mut result := #[]
  for lane in #["checkpoints","deferred"] do
    let path := directory / lane
    if !(← path.pathExists) then continue
    for entry in ← path.readDir do
      if entry.fileName.endsWith ".json" then result := result.push entry.path.toString
  return result.qsort (· < ·)

/-- Finish the actual frozen runtime's durable work, without an answering
model or reconstructed hook events. Only that executable may write the DB. -/
def cliMain (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  try
    let (drainOnly,args) := match args with
      | "--drain-only" :: rest => (true,rest)
      | _ => (false,args)
    let (kind,args) := if args.head? == some "--trial" then (StudyRecordedRun.Kind.memory,args.drop 1)
      else (.seed,args)
    let [acquisition,directory] := args |
      throw (IO.userError "NativeSeedFinalize ACQUISITION NEW-REPORT-DIRECTORY")
    let root := System.FilePath.mk acquisition
    let output := System.FilePath.mk directory
    check (root.isAbsolute && output.isAbsolute && !(← output.pathExists)) "new absolute finalization output required"
    let plan ← StudyRecordedRun.read kind root
    for artifact in plan.pluginFiles do StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact artifact
    IO.FS.createDir output
    let thread ← StudyAdmission.readJson (root / "thread.json").toString
    let session ← IO.ofExcept ((← IO.ofExcept (thread.getObjVal? "thread")).getObjValAs? String "id")
    let data := plan.data
    check ((← IO.getEnv "EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT") == some data.toString)
      "finalization probes must use the seed's actual private root"
    let files := data / "sessions" / session
    let before ← queued files
    IO.FS.writeFile (output / "queued-before.json") ((toJson before).compress ++ "\n")
    let environment := replaceEnv plan.environment #[
      ("EGGSHELL_DATA_ROOT",some data.toString),("EGGSHELL_CONFIG",some plan.configuration.toString),
      ("EGGSHELL_PROFILE",some "work"),("CODEX_THREAD_ID",some session),("CODEX_TURN_ID",none)]
    if !before.isEmpty then
      let publisher ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) data environment
      let managed ← try
        StudyRuntime.startManaged (.mk plan.runtime.path) (.mk plan.pluginRoot)
          session (data / "daemon.json") environment
        catch error =>
          StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (output / "publisher-shutdown.json")
          throw error
      try
        let deadline := (← IO.monoMsNow)+120000
        repeat
          if (← queued files).isEmpty then break
          check ((← IO.monoMsNow) < deadline) "frozen runtime did not drain its queued seed publication"
          IO.sleep 100
      finally
        try StudyRuntime.stopManaged managed (output / "shutdown.json")
        finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (output / "publisher-shutdown.json")
    let after ← queued files
    check after.isEmpty "queued source work remains after owned daemon exit"
    let ancestry ← StudySource.inspect plan.database
    IO.FS.writeFile (output / "source-ancestry.json") (toJson ancestry).compress
    StudySource.requireValid ancestry
    if drainOnly then
      let publication ← StudyRuntime.checkpoint plan.database (output / "drained.egg")
      IO.FS.writeFile (output / "result.json") ((Json.mkObj [
        ("mode",toJson "drain-only"),("runtime",toJson plan.runtime),("sourceFiles",toJson publication),
        ("queuedBefore",toJson before.size),("queuedAfter",toJson after.size),
        ("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("numericalProviderStarted",toJson false)]).compress ++ "\n")
      return 0
    -- Warm after the save/index child has exited: there is only one writer.
    let preparation ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk plan.runtime.path) data environment
    let (replay,warm) ← try
      let replay ← StudyReadiness.finishJournal plan.runtime.path plan.database environment plan.workspace (output/"finish-replay")
      let warm ← StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["egg","warm","work"] environment
        plan.workspace "" (output / "warm") 240000
      pure (replay,warm)
      finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged preparation (output/"preparation-publisher-shutdown.json")
    check (warm.exitCode == 0) "frozen runtime warm failed"
    let coverage := (← StudyReadiness.warm warm plan.database).coverage
    let prepared ← DB.PageMap.pin plan.database
    let target : Eggshell.Plugin.IndexTarget := {
      owner := DB.Sidecar.Owner.ofSnapshot prepared
      command := [plan.runtime.path,"search-provider"]
      storage := .database}
    let numericalAndOriginalViews := !(← Eggshell.Warm.required target prepared)
    let sharedSynapses := !(← Synapses.Build.required prepared .database)
    let journalExists := (← Synapses.Journal.open? prepared).isSome
    let journalReplayed := replay.complete && replay.pending == 0
    IO.FS.writeFile (output / "view-readiness.json") (Json.mkObj [
      ("source",toJson prepared.head),("numericalAndOriginalViews",toJson numericalAndOriginalViews),
      ("sharedSynapses",toJson sharedSynapses),("privateJournalPresent",toJson journalExists),
      ("privateJournalReplayed",toJson journalReplayed),("freshnessCertifiedByReplay",toJson false)]).compress
    check (numericalAndOriginalViews && sharedSynapses && journalReplayed)
      "seed preparation debt remains; retain the durable seed and finish preparation before model trials"
    let doctor ← StudyCommand.run plan.runtime.path #["egg","doctor"] environment
      plan.workspace "" (output / "doctor") 60000
    check (doctor.exitCode == 0) "frozen runtime doctor failed"
    let publication ← StudyRuntime.checkpoint plan.database (output / "ready.egg")
    StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact plan.runtime
    check ((← queued files).isEmpty) "source queue changed while finalizing the seed"
    IO.FS.writeFile (output / "result.json") ((Json.mkObj [
      ("runtime",toJson plan.runtime),("acquisition",toJson acquisition),
      ("publication",toJson (output / "ready.egg").toString),("sourceFiles",toJson publication),
      ("queuedBefore",toJson before.size),("queuedAfter",toJson after.size),
      ("coverage",coverage),("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),
      ("syntheticHookEvents",toJson (0 : Nat)),("directRelationInsertions",toJson (0 : Nat)),
      ("productionAdoption",toJson false)]).compress ++ "\n")
    return 0
  catch error =>
    IO.eprintln error.toString
    return 1

end Eggshell.Research.NativeSeedFinalize

open Lean Eggshell.Research

/-- One research executable shares the native libraries across guard, source
audit, daemon management, metadata inspection and cost replay. -/
def studyMain (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  try
    match args with
    | "bootstrap" :: rest => StudyBootstrap.cliMain rest
    | ["study-prompts",spec,workspace,output] =>
        unless !(← (System.FilePath.mk output).pathExists) do throw (IO.userError "keep existing prompts")
        let prompts ← IO.ofExcept ((← StudyAdmission.readJson spec).getObjValAs? (Array String) "prompts")
        unless prompts.size == 4 do throw (IO.userError "expected seed and three fixed topic prompts")
        IO.FS.createDirAll output
        for index in [:prompts.size] do
          IO.FS.writeFile (System.FilePath.mk output / s!"topic-{index}.txt")
            (prompts[index]!.replace "<LLVM_SOURCE>" workspace)
        return 0
    | "artifacts" :: paths =>
        let artifacts ← paths.toArray.mapM fun path => StudyPrepare.artifact (.mk path)
        IO.println (toJson artifacts).pretty
        return 0
    | ["json-fields",path] =>
        let object ← IO.ofExcept ((← StudyAdmission.readJson path).getObj?)
        IO.println (toJson (object.toArray.map Prod.fst)).pretty
        return 0
    | "guard" :: rest => ResourceGuard.cliMain rest
    | "runtime" :: rest => StudyRuntime.cliMain rest
    | ["source-ancestry",database,report] => do
        unless !(← (System.FilePath.mk report).pathExists) do throw (IO.userError "preserve ancestry evidence")
        let result ← StudySource.inspect (.mk database)
        IO.FS.writeFile report (toJson result).compress
        IO.println (toJson result).compress
        return 0
    | "history" :: rest => StudyHistory.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "audit" :: rest => NativeTrialAudit.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "replay" :: rest => StudyAccounting.cliMain rest
    | ["generation-space",directory] =>
        ResourceGuard.requireGenerationSpace (.mk directory)
        return 0
    | ["trial",input,digest] => StudyTrial.run input digest
    | ["trial-bounded",input,digest,budget,budgetDigest] => do
        StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact ⟨budget,budgetDigest⟩
        let limits ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := StudyTrial.Limits) (← StudyAdmission.readJson budget))
        StudyTrial.run input digest (some limits)
    | ["acquire",input,digest] => StudyAcquire.run input digest
    | ["acquire-bounded",input,digest,budget,budgetDigest] => do
        StudyAdmission.verifyArtifact ⟨budget,budgetDigest⟩
        let limits ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := StudyTrial.Limits) (← StudyAdmission.readJson budget))
        StudyAcquire.run input digest (some limits)
    | ["profile-checks",directory,prototype] => StudyProfileChecks.run directory prototype; return 0
    | ["readiness-checks",warm,database,report] =>
        StudyReadiness.checks (.mk warm) (.mk database) (.mk report)
        return 0
    | ["preparation-check",directory] => StudyPreparationChecks.run directory; return 0
    | ["stage-prepare",input,digest] => StudyStages.run input digest; return 0
    | ["stage-close",stage,digest,output] => StudyStageClose.run stage digest output; return 0
    | ["stage-close-checks",exchange,failedRun,output] =>
        StudyStageClose.checks exchange failedRun output; return 0
    | "seed-checks" :: rest => StudySeedChecks.cliMain rest
    | ["shared-project-reader",input,source,directory] => do
        SharedProjectLifecycle.repairReader input source directory
        return 0
    | ["shared-project-lifecycle",input,directory] => do
        SharedProjectLifecycle.run input directory
        return 0
    | ["seed-checks-generic",input,directory] => do
        StudySeedChecks.run input directory (remote := true) (literal := true) (generic := true)
        return 0
    | "seed-audit" :: rest => NativeSeedAudit.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "seed-finalize" :: rest => NativeSeedFinalize.cliMain rest
    | "read-coverage" :: rest => ReadCoverageAudit.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "source-row-replay" :: rest => SourceReadPostingReplay.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "seal" :: rest => StudySeal.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "test-environment" :: rest => StudyEnvironmentChecks.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "test-command" :: rest => StudyCommandChecks.cliMain rest; return 0
    | "test-transport" :: rest => StudyTransportChecks.cliMain rest
    | ["test-budgets",fixture,directory] => do
        StudyBudgetChecks.run fixture directory
        return 0
    | "prepare-matched-source" :: rest => PrepareMatchedSource.cliMain rest; return 0
    | ["prepare",input,directory] =>
        let _ ← StudyPrepare.prepare input directory
        return 0
    | ["prepare-live",input,directory] =>
        let _ ← StudyPrepare.prepare input directory true
        return 0
    | ["test-admission",input,directory] =>
        StudyAdmissionChecks.run input directory
        return 0
    | ["probe",input] =>
        let settings ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (α := StudyTransport.Settings) (← StudyAdmission.readJson input))
        StudyTransport.probe settings
        return 0
    | ["admit",input,digest,output] =>
        if ← (System.FilePath.mk output).pathExists then throw (IO.userError "keep the existing admission report")
        let admitted ← StudyAdmission.admit input digest
        let report := Json.mkObj [("label",toJson admitted.plan.label),("purpose",toJson admitted.plan.purpose),
          ("model",toJson admitted.plan.model),("effort",toJson admitted.plan.effort),
          ("stage",toJson admitted.plan.stage),("topic",toJson admitted.plan.topic),
          ("bodySha256",toJson admitted.bodySha256),("knownOmissions",toJson admitted.knownOmissions),
          ("liveDoctor",admitted.liveDoctor),
          ("sourceAudit",admitted.audit),("productionAdoption",toJson false)]
        IO.FS.writeFile (.mk output) (report.compress ++ "\n")
        return 0
    | _ => throw (IO.userError "StudyMain guard|runtime|audit|replay|probe|admit ...")
  catch error =>
    IO.eprintln error.toString
    return 1

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := studyMain args
